definitions.explanation: A narrow stretch of sea between two areas of land, connecting two larger bodies of water.

examples.japanese: {海峡|かいきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。
examples.english: We cross the strait by boat.

examples.japanese: {津軽|つがる}{海峡|かいきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}っている→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: A tunnel runs under the Tsugaru Strait.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{海峡|かいきょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧、⟦{連絡船|れんらくせん}→連絡船：09262_renrakusen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{欠航|けっこう}→欠航：09509_kekkou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In winter the strait was very windy, and the ferries were often cancelled.

notes:
Used as a suffix in place names: {津軽|つがる}{海峡|かいきょう} (between Honshu and Hokkaido), {関門|かんもん}{海峡|かいきょう} (between Honshu and Kyushu), ドーバー{海峡|かいきょう} (the Strait of Dover). It is also a stock image in ⟦{演歌|えんか}→演歌：07082_enka⟧ songs about parting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海峡|かいきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: to cross a strait
- {海峡|かいきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隔|へだ}てる→隔てる：18729_hedateru⟧: to be separated by a strait
- {海峡|かいきょう}⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧: undersea tunnel beneath a strait

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{湾|わん}→湾：03796_wan⟧: bay, gulf — water partly enclosed by land, not a passage between two seas
